provenance.annotation_policy: Each expected group represents one required central subject; alternatives must be useful wording observed in the eligible source. # Rainwater harvesting

Rainwater harvesting could supply the garden during dry weeks. A first-flush diverter keeps roof debris out of the storage barrel. I want to compare the first-flush diverter options before buying the barrel.

# Spaced repetition

Spaced repetition helps me schedule French vocabulary reviews. Active recall means answering before looking at the solution; I also call this retrieval practice. Retrieval practice exposes gaps that rereading hides. My spaced repetition cards should require active recall.

# WireGuard

WireGuard connects my laptop to the home server. Split tunneling keeps ordinary browsing outside the VPN. I need to test split tunneling on the train before relying on WireGuard for remote backups.
